body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.title: Abstract: What Politicians Imply
paras: This study examines **implicature** in 40 televised interviews. Where a politician is asked a direct question, **evasion** is rarely a flat refusal; more often the speaker **implies** an answer without **committing** to it. Coders then recorded what viewers **inferred**. The data **suggest** that audiences **infer** agreement far more often than speakers **explicitly state** it.

The findings **indicate**, **though they do not prove**, that **plausible deniability** is built into political talk. They also **imply** a methodological caution: **inferences** reported by viewers may **reflect** the viewers’ own views as much as the speaker’s intent. **Further work is needed**.

items.q: Politicians usually refuse to answer flatly.
items.why: evasion is rarely a flat refusal.

items.q: The study proves plausible deniability exists.

items.why: implicature = o que se comunica além do dito.

blocks.cap: suggest × imply × infer: uso em textos acadêmicos

blocks.body: Em textos acadêmicos, **os dados suggest/indicate**, **o autor imply**, **o leitor infer**. *Data* pode ser plural (formal) ou singular (comum).
Evite *the data prove*: dados raramente “provam”. Prefira *suggest, indicate, are consistent with*.

items.s: The data ___ that audiences infer agreement. (suggest)
The speaker ___ an answer without committing. (imply)
The findings ___ a need for caution. (indicate)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.pt: Então o falante dá a entender?
Muitas vezes, sim, sem se comprometer.

body: **Read too much into it.** — Ler demais nas entrelinhas.
**Leave it unsaid.** — Deixar subentendido.
**Wink and nod.** — Piscar e acenar (insinuar).
**Drop a hint.** — Soltar uma indireta.
**Skirt the issue.** — Contornar a questão.
**Dodge the question.** — Fugir da pergunta.
**Beat about the bush.** — Fazer rodeios.
**Spin the answer.** — Enviesar a resposta.
**Cover oneself.** — Resguardar-se.
**Say one thing, mean another.** — Dizer uma coisa e querer dizer outra.
**Does the study prove that politicians deceive?** — O estudo prova que políticos enganam?
**So the speaker implies?** — Então o falante dá a entender?
**Often, yes, without committing.** — Muitas vezes, sim, sem se comprometer.

blocks.title: Methods seminar
lines: Does the study prove that politicians deceive?
O estudo prova que políticos enganam?
No. The data suggest that viewers infer more than speakers state.
Não. Os dados sugerem que espectadores inferem mais do que os falantes declaram.
Então o falante dá a entender?
Muitas vezes, sim, sem se comprometer.

items.label: Ajuste refinado de entonação
items.note: Ajuste refinado de entonação: pequenas variações de altura e de ritmo mudam a atitude (cortesia, ironia, reserva, compromisso) sem mudar as palavras.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence abstract on how people interpret indirect speech, using suggest, imply and infer each at least once.
blocks.model: This study asks how listeners interpret indirect requests in workplace emails. Participants read twenty messages and reported what each writer wanted. The results suggest that readers infer urgency from short sentences. Writers, by contrast, imply politeness through softening phrases. The findings indicate a gap between intention and interpretation. Further work is needed on cross-cultural samples.
